description: Get the full detail of a single HIL approval by id (plan, ADR, security audit). A ship gate (`qa_approval`) also carries the verdicts its review chips show, and `reviews[]`: for the architect, security and QA specialists, the verdict, a plain-language reason for it (`verdictExplanation`, `blockingFindingIds`; a NEEDS_REVISION whose findings are all advisory says so), the `reviewedHeadSha`, the amend `round`, the written review, and the findings (id, severity, blocking, category, title, details, location, status). `addressedFindingIds` names what the latest amend round resolved. `architectADR` / `securityAuditResult` hold the same reports. The default response stays under ~20 KB; ask for more with `include`. Reviewer verdicts (`architectVerdict`, `securityVerdict`, `qaVerdict`) come with `<field>Label`, the word the Console shows, and `<field>Outcome` (`clean`, `non_blocking` or `blocking`). `NEEDS_REVISION` is non-blocking and the Console labels it "Advisory"; the Console's "Needs revision" means the blocking `FAIL`.

include.description: Opt-in large context. productContext adds the program brief and mockup (tens of KB); fullReviews returns each specialist report uncapped. Omit for the default.
